YOUR ACCOUNTS, YOUR WORKSPACE

Connections

Connect your Telegram user account and a Google spreadsheet.

1. Connect your gateway

Not connected

Deploy the included Python gateway on Render or your VPS. It securely holds your Telegram session. The hosted dashboard needs this service for live operations.

Keys remain in this tab’s memory. Reconnect after a page reload.

↓ Download gateway + setup guide

2. Telegram accounts (up to 3)

Not connected

Connect the gateway, then add your Telegram API details here. Get them from my.telegram.org. A bot token cannot sign in as you.

Each slot has its own phone login and session. The same API app may be used for all three accounts.

API credentials are saved privately on your gateway. They are never included in GitHub or CSV exports.

Request a login code first. Enter your two-step password only after the code is accepted.

3. Google Sheets

The link you supplied points to a Google Doc. Create a Google Sheet for rows and interactive checkboxes.

Authorize the gateway

Enable Sheets and Drive APIs. Configure GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON on the gateway, then share your sheet with its client_email as Editor.

Sync writes to the TeamRadar tab. Existing checkbox choices are preserved by contact ID.

4. Send from sheet checkboxes

01   Add the Apps Script

Open your sheet → Extensions → Apps Script. Paste sheet-trigger.gs from the gateway download.

02   Set script properties

In Project Settings, set GATEWAY_URL and DASHBOARD_KEY.

03   Add an installable trigger

Choose teamRadarOnEdit → From spreadsheet → On edit. Authorize it.

04   Save your message, then check a row

Checking “Send message” in column G sends your saved template. Delivery status appears in column H. Already sent contacts are blocked from duplicate sends. Sheet checkboxes use the sender selected when you last saved your message.

Reset workspace data

Clear saved contacts, sent-message and reply history, leads, and automation queues. Your three Telegram connections, API credentials, workspace login and message templates are kept.

Message sending delay

Each Telegram account waits between messages, including follow-ups and automatic replies. Telegram-imposed waits take priority. Daily limits stay at 15 new DM recipients and 30 group messages per account.

Connect your gateway to load sending settings.

A delay cannot guarantee protection from restrictions. Contact people who expect your message. If Telegram limits an account, sending stops without switching accounts.

Keep server awake · every 10 minutes

An external GitHub Actions schedule checks your Render server, including when this dashboard is closed. Set your public Render URL in config/keep-alive.json in the WMM repository, or the repository variable WMM_GATEWAY_URL, to activate the checks.

View scheduled checks ↗

Connect your gateway to test its public health endpoint. The external schedule needs your Render URL configured once.

The check calls /health without your dashboard password or Telegram credentials. GitHub can delay scheduled runs, so occasional wake-up delays are still possible.

Lead pipeline

ALL YOUR MESSAGES IN ONE PLACE

Message templates 5 types · 5 options each

Add up to five options per message type. Sending randomly selects one non-empty option from the matching type.

Same Telegram account throughout. Replies and follow-ups stay with the account that sent the first message. If it is unavailable, sending waits for that account.

The three-day follow-up uses template 2. It checks replies before sending and stops after a reply or a confirmed follow-up. Pausing a lead’s follow-up reminders also pauses its automatic follow-up. Your gateway must remain online.

1. Initial message2. Three-day follow-up3. Yes reply · pitch4. Yes reply · call invitation5. “No” reply · free-demo offer

1. Initial message

Sent when you start a conversation.

2. Three-day follow-up

Sent once after 72 hours without a reply, from the first message’s Telegram account. Also used for manual follow-ups.

3. Yes reply · pitch

First message after a clear yes, yeah or yeh. Uses the recipient, token and selected exchange.

4. Yes reply · call invitation

Sent separately after the pitch, once, from the same Telegram account. Automation then stops for this contact.

5. “No” reply · free-demo offer

Sent once after a clear no. Stop requests cancel automatic messages.

Each type has five slots. Fill the options you want to use; at least one option per type is required. Save changes to use them.

@username uses the recipient’s public handle or display name. $TOKEN and @TOKEN use your selected $ticker. {{exchange}} uses the exchange you chose. Existing delivery history is preserved. Yes / no templates are captured when a contact is enabled; the scheduled follow-up randomly chooses from its own saved options when it is prepared to send. Once chosen, delays and retries keep the same text.

Import sheet into Saved data

Upload a CSV, TSV or Excel file, or read a shared Google Sheet. Use a column with @username or https://t.me/username. Review the rows before importing.

Up to 1,000 rows and 30 columns. For Google Sheets, share the sheet with your gateway service-account email as Viewer. You can upload an exported file instead.

Reset workspace data

This permanently removes the workspace records listed below. Your three Telegram accounts, API credentials and message templates are kept.

Daily counters and duplicate-message history reset too. Telegram-imposed waits stay in place. Telegram chats and your connected Google Sheet stay as they are.

Reset daily limits

Reset the selected account’s app usage counters to zero. Choose which limits to reset.

Delivery history and duplicate protection stay in place. Telegram-imposed pauses are not cleared. The daily target counts confirmed sends since the applicable reset.

Send message

A clear yes sends the pitch and call invitation as two separate messages, once. Automatic replies then stop for this contact, even if they reply again. A clear no sends the free-demo offer once. Ambiguous replies wait for your review. Stop requests cancel automatic replies.

@username is filled automatically. The token field replaces $TOKEN and @TOKEN with your $ticker. If no public username exists, the saved display name is used.

Sends from the original Telegram account. Repeated DMs to the same person do not consume another new-recipient slot; group limits still apply. Sending requires a confirmed original delivery.

Lead
